page.content:
Langley mathematician whose trajectories backed Mercury and Apollo.

How Katherine Johnson connects

  • Faction: Project Mercury — Katherine Johnson's trajectories backed Mercury orbital flights.
  • Faction: Apollo program — Johnson also computed backup Apollo lunar-return paths at Langley.

What is Katherine Johnson?

Katherine Johnson computed launch windows and backup trajectories at Langley, including John Glenn's orbital flight and Apollo lunar-return paths, work later recognized as central to early NASA.

Key threads lead to Project Mercury and Apollo program.
